title: Living Artifact
question: Does a deliberately changed sandbox runner alter a canonical Paper 4 measurement while an unchanged Paper 1 verifier probe remains semantically stable when both implementation states are identified rather than silently pooled?

B.declared_delta: PluginSandboxRunner adds one cached node:vm module handle, one reusable VM context per runner, and a bounded compiled-script cache.

paper_1_verifier_control.test_name: reports verify-only vs full replay wall time
command: reports verify-only vs full replay wall time

execution_plan.isolation: detached Git worktrees; the dirty main checkout is neither checked out nor used to execute probes
execution_plan.raw_output: captured verbatim inside the receipt and SHA-256 bound

effect_envelope.paper_4_aggregation: For each metric and state, take the median of the three canonical per-run medians; then divide B by A.

vm_creation_median_ms.role: negative-control envelope because each sample constructs a new runner

jit_eval_median_ms.role: context-reuse sensitive; code varies so the compiled-script cache should contribute less

effect_envelope.p99_policy: record but do not gate because three host-local replicates do not identify scheduler-tail effects
effect_envelope.paper_1_timing_policy: record but do not compare inferentially; this probe is a semantic control and its verifier closure is identical

adjudication.mechanism_supported: All semantic gates pass, the VM-creation ratio stays inside its control envelope, and both runner-sensitive ratios stay inside their preregistered envelopes.
adjudication.partial_support: All semantic gates pass and exactly one runner-sensitive ratio stays inside its envelope.
adjudication.no_support_for_this_delta: All semantic gates pass but neither runner-sensitive ratio stays inside its envelope.
adjudication.confounded: Any semantic gate fails, required code/dependency identities fail, the runtime differs between states, or the VM-creation negative control leaves its envelope.

scope_limits: This is a host-local implementation-state comparison, not a cross-vendor or cross-runtime claim.
The Paper 4 probe measures PluginSandboxRunner overhead; it does not establish hostile-code isolation or the composed three-layer Paper 4 architecture.
W.GOLD.035 and W.GOLD.039 motivate compiler-visible security boundaries, but this runtime-runner delta does not test HS010 or prove compiler-level security.
No novelty, quantum advantage, or paper-wide reproducibility claim follows from this pilot.
